tasks.short: Supervise projects, placements, laboratory work and training.

steps.what: Read the posted placement line for this group.
Supervise field placements, laboratory work and training.

tasks.design: The vocational teacher still supervises independent or group projects, field placements, laboratory work and other training. A placement line is already posted in the {DOCS}, with group, site, date, task and the author's name, so the hunt for that sheet is shorter. Nothing sends a record, raises an alert, or fills a sheet.
tasks.previous_blocker: The placement line sat on a paper sheet, so the teacher hunted it before supervising the group on site.
tasks.enabler_now: The job file already holds a placement line. Showing group, site, date, task and the author's name is configuration of that file.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the teacher supervises the field placement, the laboratory work and the training is what happens in the room or on the site. A posted line does not supervise it.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher sees the group and the site and refuses a line that does not name them.
tasks.altitude: The week is still the class and the workshop. Less time goes to hunting a placement sheet. The teacher still supervises.

reach.task: Post the placement line before the visit.
reach.learn: The line needs group, site, date, task and the author's name, or the teacher reads the paper sheet.

reach.task: Keep the site and the task current for this group.
reach.learn: The teacher still supervises the placement. The lead does not replace that supervision.

reach.task: Stay out of the supervision unless asked into the room.
reach.learn: Talking with students on site is the teacher's own work. It is not a send outside the organisation.

evidence.claim: Supervising field placements, laboratory work and other training stays with the vocational teacher. A posted placement line can be a shorter read. The supervision itself is not shorter. Model knowledge.

Annex III point 3 covers admission, evaluating learning outcomes, setting the education level, and detecting cheating in tests. This design does not grade the placement, set a level, or detect cheating.
Emotion inference in education has been banned since February 2025. This design infers no emotion from the group or the site.
A grade set solely by a model is likely an article 22 decision, and systematic automated evaluation needs a data protection assessment. This design sets no grade.
Works-council consent is required for systems able to monitor staff. This design does not monitor the teacher while the placement is supervised.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: this task is only supervising one group's projects, field placements, laboratory work or other training. Grading, fraud decisions, lecturing other courses, research and ordering sit outside it. The placement coordinator or programme lead posts the line before the visit.

Structured input: one placement line in the {DOCS} with group, site, date, task and the author's name. If the line is missing or free text, the teacher reads the paper sheet and that read is not shorter.

The teacher still supervises in the room or on the site. Nothing is recorded by a machine, sent, or committed. Nothing sends a record, raises an alert, or fills a sheet. There is no commit and no send, so there is no gate on a sent version. The prior that reach is a write inside the organisation is accepted for the supervision itself. The prior that the step acts outside the organisation is refused: supervising students is a talk, not a send. The prior that a person must approve a sent version is refused: nothing is sent or committed.

A model is not used. The prior that a model is needed is refused: the teacher has to see the group and the site. Existing system runtime is not the teacher's time. The design does not grade, detect cheating, infer emotion, monitor the teacher, or score anyone.
unknowns: Whether this school's job file already has group, site, date, task and a name, or only a paper sheet.
Whether a host site later asks for a visit note to leave the school. This design does not file one.
research_questions: Who posts the placement line, the placement coordinator or the programme lead?
What share of placements start with no line the teacher can read?

already_counted.description: Reading a missing or free-text placement sheet by hand, inside the remaining read.

incremental.description: Checking that the placement line still names this group, site, date, task and an author.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the placement line is often missing or free text, so the teacher still hunts the paper sheet and the read is not shorter. High: most lines carry group, site, date, task and an author's name, and only that hunt shrinks. Supervising the placement stays. The high stays under the net after the field check.
